sys_hub_flow.description:
Given an ATF test suite's id, this flow will start an ATF Test Suite on the provided instance and give the suite execution results. Since running ATF suites is an on-demand request, a Scheduled client test runner is required for running ATF test suites.

Inputs:

  • Test Suite Sys Id - Sys Id of the ATF test suite.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite.
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • Browser Name - Browser name where you wish to run the scheduled client test runner. The browser names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Chrome", "Firefox", "Edge", "IE", "Safari". Default to "Any"
  • Browser Version - 'Browser version starts with' of the 'Browser' where the client test runner is running. Default to "Any".
  • OS Name - Operating System name where you wish to open the browser. The operating system names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Windows", "Mac OS X", "Linux'. Default to "Any".
  • OS Version - 'Operating System version starts with' of the 'Operating System' you wish to use to open the scheduled client test runner. Default to "Any".
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Result URL - The URL of the ATF suite execution record. You can navigate to this URL and check verify results.
  • Test Suite Duration - Total time taken to run the tests (in seconds).
  • Rolledup Test Success Count - Number of tests that are successful. This includes all the child tests that ran successfully.
  • Rolledup Test Failure Count - Number of tests that are failed. This includes all the failed child tests.
  • Rolledup Test Error Count - Number of tests that are errored. This includes all the errored child tests.
  • Rolledup Test Skip Count - Number of tests that are skipped. This includes all the skipped child tests.
  • Test Suite Name - Name of the test suite.

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • Invalid ATF Suite ID
  • ATF Schedule Run - record insert failed
  • Start ATF Suite Failed with the given Suite ID
  • Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled
  • Start ATF Suite With ID or Name feature is not available. The property is disabled
  • Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
Given an ATF test suite's id, this flow will start an ATF Test Suite on the provided instance and give the suite execution results. Since running ATF suites is an on-demand request, a Scheduled client test runner is required for running ATF test suites.

Inputs:

  • Test Suite Sys Id - Sys Id of the ATF test suite.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite.
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role.
  • Browser Name - Browser name where you wish to run the scheduled client test runner. The browser names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Chrome", "Firefox", "Edge", "IE", "Safari". Default to "Any"
  • Browser Version - 'Browser version starts with' of the 'Browser' where the client test runner is running. Default to "Any".
  • OS Name - Operating System name where you wish to open the browser. The operating system names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Windows", "Mac OS X", "Linux'. Default to "Any".
  • OS Version - 'Operating System version starts with' of the 'Operating System' you wish to use to open the scheduled client test runner. Default to "Any".
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Result URL - The URL of the ATF suite execution record. You can navigate to this URL and check verify results.
  • Test Suite Duration - Total time taken to run the tests (in seconds).
  • Rolledup Test Success Count - Number of tests that are successful. This includes all the child tests that ran successfully.
  • Rolledup Test Failure Count - Number of tests that are failed. This includes all the failed child tests.
  • Rolledup Test Error Count - Number of tests that are errored. This includes all the errored child tests.
  • Rolledup Test Skip Count - Number of tests that are skipped. This includes all the skipped child tests.
  • Test Suite Name - Name of the test suite.

Error Messages:

  • User does not have access to CICD role
  • Invalid ATF Suite ID
  • ATF Schedule Run - record insert failed
  • Start ATF Suite Failed with the given Suite ID
  • Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled
  • Start ATF Suite With ID or Name feature is not available. The property is disabled
  • Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>true</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=chrome,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=196940750000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="ATF">a12e18a6773f3300d4bdaeca78106156</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Given an ATF test suite's id, this flow will start an ATF Test Suite on the provided instance and give the suite execution results. Since running ATF suites is an on-demand request, a Scheduled client test runner is required for running ATF test suites. </p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Test Suite Sys Id</b> - Sys Id of the ATF test suite. </li>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite. </li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role. </li>
   <li><b>Browser Name</b> - Browser name where you wish to run the scheduled client test runner. The browser names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Chrome", "Firefox", "Edge", "IE", "Safari". Default to "Any" </li>
   <li><b>Browser Version</b> - 'Browser version starts with' of the 'Browser' where the client test runner is running. Default to "Any".</li>
   <li><b>OS Name</b> - Operating System name where you wish to open the browser. The operating system names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Windows", "Mac OS X", "Linux'. Default to "Any". </li>
   <li><b>OS Version</b> - 'Operating System version starts with' of the 'Operating System' you wish to use to open the scheduled client test runner. Default to "Any". </li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
  <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”. </li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
   <li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
   <li><b>Result URL</b> - The URL of the ATF suite execution record. You can navigate to this URL and check verify results. </li>
   <li><b>Test Suite Duration</b> - Total time taken to run the tests (in seconds).</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Success Count</b> - Number of tests that are successful. This includes all the child tests that ran successfully.</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Failure Count</b> - Number of tests that are failed. This includes all the failed child tests.</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Error Count</b> - Number of tests that are errored. This includes all the errored child tests. </li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Skip Count</b> - Number of tests that are skipped. This includes all the skipped child tests. </li>
   <li><b>Test Suite Name</b> - Name of the test suite. </li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</b></li>
   <li>Invalid ATF Suite ID</li>
   <li>ATF Schedule Run - record insert failed</li>
   <li>Start ATF Suite Failed with the given Suite ID</li>
   <li>Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
   <li>Start ATF Suite With ID or Name feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
   <li>Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn More</a></p>
</description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority/><generation_source/><internal_name>cicd_atf_suite_start_with_id</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.api_version","label":"Input➛API display_value="ATF">a12e18a6773f3300d4bdaeca78106156</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>Given an ATF test suite's id, this flow will start an ATF Test Suite on the provided instance and give the suite execution results. Since running ATF suites is an on-demand request, a Scheduled client test runner is required for running ATF test suites. </p>
<p><b>Inputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li><b>Test Suite Sys Id</b> - Sys Id of the ATF test suite. </li>
   <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where you wish to start the test suite. </li>
   <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role. </li>
   <li><b>Browser Name</b> - Browser name where you wish to run the scheduled client test runner. The browser names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Chrome", "Firefox", "Edge", "IE", "Safari". Default to "Any" </li>
   <li><b>Browser Version</b> - 'Browser version starts with' of the 'Browser' where the client test runner is running. Default to "Any".</li>
   <li><b>OS Name</b> - Operating System name where you wish to open the browser. The operating system names should be exactly matching with one of the following. "Windows", "Mac OS X", "Linux'. Default to "Any". </li>
   <li><b>OS Version</b> - 'Operating System version starts with' of the 'Operating System' you wish to use to open the scheduled client test runner. Default to "Any". </li>
   <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Outputs:</p>
</b>
<ul>
  <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”. </li>
   <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.</li>
   <li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
   <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
   <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
   <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
   <li><b>Result URL</b> - The URL of the ATF suite execution record. You can navigate to this URL and check verify results. </li>
   <li><b>Test Suite Duration</b> - Total time taken to run the tests (in seconds).</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Success Count</b> - Number of tests that are successful. This includes all the child tests that ran successfully.</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Failure Count</b> - Number of tests that are failed. This includes all the failed child tests.</li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Error Count</b> - Number of tests that are errored. This includes all the errored child tests. </li>
   <li><b>Rolledup Test Skip Count</b> - Number of tests that are skipped. This includes all the skipped child tests. </li>
   <li><b>Test Suite Name</b> - Name of the test suite. </li>
</ul>
<p><b>Error Messages:</p>
</b>
<ul>
   <li>User does not have access to CICD role</b></li>
   <li>Invalid ATF Suite ID</li>
   <li>ATF Schedule Run - record insert failed</li>
   <li>Start ATF Suite Failed with the given Suite ID</li>
   <li>Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
   <li>Start ATF Suite With ID or Name feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
   <li>Get ATF Suite Execution Results feature is not available. The property is disabled</li>
</ul>
<p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn More</a></p>
